slides.text:
Ranking the numbers
on your watch

5 — Active calories

A guess dressed as a number

4 — Steps

Honest, but it can't tell
a commute from training

3 — Resting heart rate

Slow, boring, quietly the
most honest one here

2 — Sleep

The input everything else
is downstream of

slides.heading: 1 — The one that changes your day
slides.body: None of them alone. SOMA reads them together and returns the only number that matters: what to do today
